name: meter
need: Show a share of a known whole as a segmented bar, a ring, a gauge or a bar gauge, with thresholds

--ds-meter-threshold.description: a threshold mark across a meter or a gauge (`.ds-meter__threshold`, `.ds-gauge__threshold`)

--ds-gauge-size.description: `.ds-gauge`: the width and height at md, 16px per size step

--ds-gauge-thickness.description: `.ds-gauge`: the ring's width at md, 2px per size step

--ds-bar-gauge-warning.description: `.ds-bar-gauge`: the share where the warning zone starts, set on the element with the data

--ds-bar-gauge-error.description: `.ds-bar-gauge`: the share where the error zone starts, set on the element with the data

physical..ds-meter--segmented: mask-image: the parts are cut left to right as the chart meter fills (.ds-meter clips its fill from the right in every direction)
physical..ds-bar-gauge__track: --_zones: the zones lie along the fill, which grows left to right as the chart meter's
physical..ds-bar-gauge__track: mask-image: the cells are cut left to right along the fill
physical..ds-bar-gauge__track: background: forced colours: each zone's hatch from its share to the right end, as the zones lie along the fill, which grows left to right
physical..ds-bar-gauge__track::before: background: forced colours: the unlit cells' zone hatches from each share to the right end, as on the track
